This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimant being aggrieved of the award dated 05.02.2024 passed by the Member 5th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal (M.P.) in Claim Case No.1620/2022.

entities.text: 5th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellants that appellant sustained cent percent disability on account of grievous injuries, but learned Tribunal has awarded arbitrary compensation without taking into consideration the law on the subject.
Smt. Amrit Kaur Ruprah, learned counsel for the Insurance company, in his turn, supports the impugned award and submits that no indulgence is called for in the same.

At this stage, it is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that it has come on record that claimant is a salaried employee and he was working as a computer operator at Nagar Nigam, Bhopal drawing salary of Rs.9,636/-
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12419 2 MA-1904-2024 per month, therefore,
Tribunal has wrongly added 40% towards future prospects whereas addition should have been of 50%.

Thus, when 50% is added towards the accepted income of Rs.9,391/- per month, then it comes out to Rs.14,086.50/- or addition will be to the tune of Rs.4.695.50/- in place of Rs.3,756/- as has been Arjun vs Bhanupratap Singh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54519834/
1 added by the learned Tribunal.
Thus, when loss of earning is taken as 14,086.50/- per month, then it comes out to Rs.1,69,038/- per annum in place of Rs.1,57,764/- computed by learned Tribunal.

Tribunal has applied multiplier of 17, which is when applied, then total compensation under the head of loss of earning capacity will come out to Rs. 28,73,646/- (Rupees Twenty Eight Lakh Seventy Three Thousand Six Hundred Forty Six Only) in place of Rs.26,81,988/- (Rupees Twenty Six Lakh Eighty One Thousand Nine Hundred Eighty Eight Only) awarded by the Tribunal.

Thus,
there will be addition of Rs.01,91,658/- (Rupees One Lakh Ninety One Thousand Six Hundred Fifty Eight Only) under this head.

Besides this, learned Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh Only) under the head of loss of enjoyment of married life, which is enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh Only), thus, there will be addition of Rs.4,00,000/-
(Rupees Four Lakh Only) under the head of loss of enjoyment of married life.

Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh Only) under the head of loss of amenities, which is enhanced to Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakh Only), thus, there will be addition of Rs.2,00,000/-
(Rupees Two Lakh Only) under the head of loss of amenities.

Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh Only) under the head of pain and suffering, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12419 3 MA-1904-2024 which is enhanced to Rs.15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh Only), thus, there will be addition of Rs.14,00,000/- (Rupees Fourteen Lakh Only) under the head of pain and suffering.

Tribunal has awarded only a sum of Rs.3,00,000/-(Rupees Three Lakh Only) under the head of loss of future treatment, which is enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh Only), thus, there will be addition of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Only) under the head of loss of future treatment.

Thus, there will be total enhancement to the tune of Rs.23,91,658/- (Rupees Twenty Three Lakh Ninety One Thousand Six Hundred Fifty Eight Only) in the light of the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Baby Sakshi Greola Vs. Manzoor Ahmad Simon and Another, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 3692, which will be admissible to the claimant alongwith interest @ 7% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till the date of actual payment.

Accordingly, this appeal is disposed of.
Record of the Tribunal be sent back immediately.
